audit_item: A10 / orchestrator and WFO persisted JSON identity integrity
finding: The orchestrator configuration loader and persisted run/checkpoint metadata readers, plus WFO bundle, protocol manifest, completion receipt, report, selection, baseline, and Holdout readers, used default JSON decoding. Duplicate object keys were silently resolved by last-value-wins semantics.
change: Added rles_orchestrator.json_utils.loads_unique_json and routed every application.py and wfo_application.py JSON parse through it. Recursive duplicate keys now raise JSONDecodeError before parsed values can influence configuration, recovery, query receipts, or report identity.

verification.pytest_source: tests/test_application_cli.py + tests/test_research_wfo.py: 78 passed against current source roots
verification.pytest_installed_wheels: same selectors: 78 passed with PYTHONPATH unset after installing the RouteB orchestrator wheel
verification.pytest_combined_current_source: tests/world_model + tests/test_application_cli.py + tests/test_research_wfo.py: 289 passed, 14 skipped (JAX-only cases skipped in app venv; exact JAX CPU workflow selector separately passed 11)
verification.ruff: passed on new helper, both modified modules, and both test files
verification.mypy: passed on the 3 orchestrator source modules with import-untyped disabled for internal wheels without py.typed
verification.targeted_regressions: Duplicate nested config market_path and digest-verified WFO bundle scaler mean keys are rejected. All other application and WFO persisted JSON paths use the same helper.

scope: Only synthetic temporary config and bundle fixtures were used. No market, account, project registry, Validation, Test, or Holdout payload was accessed.
